claims.evidence: No photo evidence of location/usage history; only seller text.

claims.claim: The AR-M207 is packed with an extensive range of superb performance functions, delivering...

risks.risk: Condition/working status is unknown (no power-on test, no prints, no error codes).
risks.proof: A short video clip of the machine powered on and making a few copies (including a test print from the copier screen/controls).
risks.if_unproven: Price as not proven working (worst case for used unit).

risks.risk: Toner/drum/developer and consumables may be low or worn, affecting print quality and cost to fix.
risks.proof: Clear close-up photos of the toner level/consumable indicators (or a print sample showing density/lines) plus a copy showing clean output.
risks.if_unproven: Price as needing consumables/possible service (worst case for image quality).

risks.risk: Paper handling issues (feed rollers, misfeeds) can’t be confirmed from wrapped photos.
risks.proof: Video showing feeding A4/A3 from the tray(s) and completing a full run without jams.
risks.if_unproven: Price as possible paper-feed faults (worst case).

risks.risk: Counter/usage hours and maintenance history are unknown; affects value.
risks.proof: Photo of the machine’s counter/maintenance screen (or a video showing it).

risks.risk: Accessories/connectivity (ADF, duplex unit, network/USB, cables) may be missing.
risks.proof: Photo checklist of included parts + a shot showing ADF/duplex operation (if present) during copying.

proof_requests: Send a video of the copier powered on and producing clear copies (no errors) for at least 2–3 pages.
Send a photo/video of the counter/maintenance screen.
Send a close-up of toner/consumable status and a sample print showing no streaks/lines.
Confirm included parts (power cable, any network/USB accessories, and whether ADF/duplex are present) with photos.
response.reason: The model identity (Sharp AR-M207) is readable, but there is no proof the unit works or its print quality/paper handling is good; without that, a reliable worst-case price cannot be set from the provided photos alone.
